definitions.explanation: A written or printed symbol representing a sound or concept in a language.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{文字|もじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{読|よ}みますか→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: How do you read this character?

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文字|もじ}⟦{体系|たいけい}→体系：04487_taikei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.notes: ひらがな, カタカナ, ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧

examples.japanese: {文字|もじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{書|か}いてください→書く：00477_kaku⟧。

notes:
{文字|もじ} is the general term for any written character or letter, regardless of writing system.

PRONUNCIATION:
- もじ: the standard reading
- もんじ: a less common variant reading (same meaning)

RELATED WORDS (writing systems):
- ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧: kanji (Chinese characters)
- ひらがな: hiragana
- カタカナ: katakana
- ⟦アルファベット→アルファベット：10709_arufabetto⟧: alphabet (Latin characters)

SEE ALSO: ⟦{文字|もんじ}→文字：00290_monji⟧ (alternative reading/form)
